title: FBI links record $6.3 billion Binance crypto theft to North Korea
summary:

title: Seoul Biosys Begins Production of Rare Earth-Free White Micro LEDs
summary:
Seoul Biosys has commenced the production of micro LEDs that generate white light without the use of rare earth elements.
Typically, white LEDs use blue chips combined with rare earth phosphors like yttrium aluminum garnet (YAG) to produce white light.
Seoul Biosys explained that its WICOP technology enables the creation of white light without rare earth elements or separate packaging.
Seoul Semiconductor and Seoul Biosys have been developing ultraviolet (UV), blue, green, red, and infrared (IR) micro LEDs based on this technology, and have now expanded its application to include white light.
Starting in the fourth quarter, Seoul Semiconductor and Seoul Biosys will prioritize supplying the third-generation WICOP products to existing major clients while jointly exploring new application markets.

title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
summary:
In BriefAI hasn’t benefited the bottom line of any big corporations outside the tech industry, according to a note recently published by the chief economist at Apollo Global Management (the private equity giant that used to own TechCrunch).
Apollo’s Torsten Slok focuses on what he calls the S&P 493 — the S&P 500, minus Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Tesla — finding that profit margins and revenue per worker appear to be flat, with no evidence that AI is improving productivity.
“Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech,” Slok said.
Is this simply a matter of non-tech companies lagging behind the tech giants?
Slok sounded skeptical, arguing that it will be tough for corporate America to “turn increasingly cheap intelligence into higher revenue growth and higher profit margins.”“AI may be a great calculator, but in business, intelligence is mostly judgment,” he wrote, later adding, “AI does not understand accountability, trust, culture, unwritten rules, ethical trade-offs or fairness, all of which shape reputational risk and ultimately drive revenue growth and profit margins.”Recent studies have also found that AI has yet to deliver significant productivity gains.

title: Microsoft AI chief says AI is not conscious and we should keep it that way
